messages.detail: New Arcadia sustained healthy finances, employment, utilities, and livability for 12 consecutive days. The Charter is permanent; a Regional Capital mandate arrives by Day 228.
messages.title: Town Charter Awarded

messages.detail: Reach 500 residents, $10,000 treasury, non-negative cashflow, 90% employment, full utilities with 15% reserve, and 52% happiness; keep every zone active for 12 consecutive days. Growth needs job openings and utility headroom.
messages.title: Town Charter Standards

messages.detail: 500 residents. Growth alone is not enough: protect the treasury, jobs, utilities, and livability to earn the Town Charter.
messages.title: Population Milestone

messages.detail: Utility reserves absorbed the freight surge. Reliable factories renewed the contract and repaid the $5,500 disruption cost.
messages.title: Freight Network Secured

messages.detail: Early reserve utilities absorbed the surge. The city avoided the $5,500 shock after committing capital and upkeep to capacity.
messages.title: Industrial Load Absorbed

messages.detail: The freight surge lands by Day 65. A second power plant and water tower, or a second park, prevents the load shock; waiting preserves capital now but risks $5,500 and livability.
messages.title: Freight Load Forecast

messages.detail: Doubling down on factories won a $6,500 freight return and more jobs. The faster payoff brings heavier pollution and utility exposure before the load surge.
messages.title: Regional Freight Contract

messages.detail: Power or water is below current use. Growth has stalled and livability will keep falling until capacity or demand changes.
messages.title: Utility Shortfall

messages.detail: Industrial expansion is committed. A regional freight contract arrives by Day 33; reserve power and water or a second park can absorb the load complication that follows.
messages.title: Freight Contract Watch

messages.detail: Only 22 power and 25 water remain spare. Build a Power Plant ($12,000) before adding more homes or jobs.
messages.title: Utility Reserve Tight

messages.detail: Strong demand has attracted denser development.
messages.title: Neighborhood Upgraded
